[[File:Sith_Gloves.jpg|thumb|A pair of Sith gloves]]

Used extensively by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the '''Sith gloves''' were made of alloy containing [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]] and were designed with a purpose to resist a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strike. While a skilled Master aware of their nature could get through them, most others could not.
